title: Ad-free TV dashboard
text: Connects to a living-room TV over ADB, strips the launcher ads, and replaces the screensaver with a live calendar and weather dashboard.

title: Router logs to alerts
text: Parses a home router's syslog stream, learns which devices normally talk to which hosts, and texts an alert when a smart bulb contacts a new server.

title: Thermostat schedule tuner
text: Reads a year of smart-thermostat history and rewrites the heating schedule to cut gas use while keeping bedrooms warm at wake-up time.

title: Head unit firmware audit
text: Reverse-engineers a car head unit's firmware and finds an always-on microphone, a hidden call recorder, and a vendor backdoor.

title: Phishing triage queue
text: Sorts a shared inbox of suspicious emails by checking links, headers, and lookalike domains, then drafts a one-line verdict for each.

title: Password leak cross-check
text: Compares a household's exported password list against breach corpora offline and ranks which accounts to rotate first.

title: Protein paper digest
text: Reads 200 preprints on protein folding, extracts the reported methods and benchmarks, and builds a table showing which results never got replicated.

title: Telescope data cleanup
text: Writes a pipeline that removes cosmic-ray streaks and satellite trails from amateur telescope exposures before stacking them.

title: Soil sensor anomaly finder
text: Analyzes two seasons of field soil-moisture readings, flags sensors that drifted, and proposes a recalibration schedule.

title: Lab results explainer
text: Translates a blood panel into plain language, lists which values sit outside the reference range, and prepares questions for the next doctor visit.

title: Sleep log patterns
text: Correlates a year of wearable sleep scores with caffeine, travel, and workout notes and reports the three habits that move sleep most.

title: Physio exercise planner
text: Turns a physiotherapist's handwritten notes into a week-by-week stretching routine with a short checklist for each day.

title: Invoice chaser
text: Scans a freelancer's sent invoices, finds the overdue ones, and drafts polite reminders that escalate in tone every seven days.

title: Shop margin analysis
text: Joins an online shop's order export with supplier costs and shows which products lose money once returns and shipping are counted.

title: Tax receipt sorter
text: Sorts a folder of 600 scanned receipts into deductible categories and produces a spreadsheet an accountant can check line by line.

title: Meeting notes to tasks
text: Converts a rambling weekly meeting transcript into decisions, owners, and due dates, and files each task in the team's tracker.

title: Inbox zero rules
text: Studies a manager's last 5,000 emails and writes filter rules that route newsletters, receipts, and routine approvals out of the inbox.

title: Spreadsheet to report
text: Turns a quarterly sales spreadsheet into a six-page report with charts, a plain summary, and a list of anomalies to investigate.

title: Legacy test harness
text: Adds characterization tests around an undocumented billing module so a team can refactor it without changing what customers are charged.

title: Migration script writer
text: Writes and dry-runs a database migration that splits one wide table into three, with a rollback script for each step.

title: Build time profiler
text: Profiles a monorepo's continuous integration runs, finds the slowest steps, and caches them to cut build time from 40 to 14 minutes.

title: Bedtime story generator
text: Writes a bedtime story each night starring a child's stuffed animals, reusing characters from earlier nights so the world stays consistent.

title: School forms wrangler
text: Collects permission slips and sports schedules from three children's school emails and merges them into one family calendar.

title: Homework hint coach
text: Walks a ten-year-old through fraction problems with hints instead of answers and tells the parent which skills need more practice.

title: Podcast highlight cutter
text: Transcribes a two-hour interview, picks the five most quotable moments, and cuts them into vertical clips with captions.

title: Album art variations
text: Generates thirty cover-art variations from a band's mood notes and narrows them to three that match the record's palette.

title: Screenplay continuity check
text: Reads a feature screenplay and lists every continuity error, such as characters changing clothes or knowing facts they never learned.

title: Board game rules referee
text: Reads a board game's rulebook and answers disputed rules at the table with the exact page and rule it relied on.

title: Roguelike level tuner
text: Simulates ten thousand runs of a roguelike prototype and adjusts enemy spawn tables until the win rate lands near fifteen percent.

title: Tabletop campaign recap
text: Condenses six hours of recorded role-playing session audio into a two-page recap with unresolved plot threads for the next game master.

title: Language drill partner
text: Runs daily spoken Spanish drills built from the learner's own mistakes in the previous week's conversations.

title: Exam question miner
text: Extracts recurring question types from ten years of past physics exams and builds a revision plan ordered by how often each topic appears.

title: Textbook to flashcards
text: Turns a chapter of an anatomy textbook into spaced-repetition flashcards with diagrams described in words and a hard-mode set.

title: Group chat peacemaker
text: Summarizes a heated family group chat, points out where two people are actually agreeing, and suggests a calm reply.

title: Gift idea memory
text: Keeps a running list of things friends mention wanting during conversations and suggests a gift with a budget before each birthday.

title: Lease clause reviewer
text: Reads a 30-page rental lease, flags clauses that deviate from local tenant law, and explains each in two sentences.

title: Council meeting digest
text: Watches a city council's three-hour meeting recordings and posts a neighborhood newsletter of the votes that affect zoning and transit.

title: Hiking route planner
text: Builds a three-day backpacking itinerary from trail maps, water sources, and weather forecasts, with a bail-out option for each day.

title: Flight deal watcher
text: Tracks fares for a flexible week-long trip across six airports and alerts when a combination drops below a set price.

title: Pantry recipe matcher
text: Looks at a photo of an open pantry and proposes three dinners that use what is there, with one extra ingredient to buy at most.

title: Sourdough troubleshooting
text: Reads a baker's photo log of failed loaves and the feeding schedule, then identifies the starter problem and a fix to try.

title: Poetry for a retirement
text: Drafts a short poem for a retiring colleague by weaving in details from thirty years of office emails and farewell messages.
